The same guide the app shows under Device → Help & how-to, one page per topic.

## Start here

- [Getting started](getting-started.md): Take over the radio, pick a channel, talk.

## On the intercom

- [Intercom](intercom.md): The main page: channel, talk key, activity.
- [Scanning and zones](scanning-and-zones.md): SCAN searches a zone; ZONE picks one.
- [Soft SQ](soft-sq.md): A smarter squelch for weak signals.
- [Live captions](live-captions.md): TXT turns received speech into text.
- [VFO](vfo.md): Tune any frequency without a saved channel.
- [Record and monitor](record-and-monitor.md): REC saves audio; MON hears every DMR call.
- [Packet radio](packet-radio.md): APRS, APRS-IS, TNC, parrot, Morse, DTMF, weather alerts, SSTV.

- [Logbook](logbook.md): Your contacts, and the stations the radio heard.

- [Messages](messages.md): DMR texts, M17 texts and pager threads.
- [Device](device.md): Radio link, settings and tools.
